attributes.name: card image presence
attributes.definition: Whether content cards include imagery (thumbnails, product images, logos, avatars) or are purely textual.

values.definition: Cards contain no images, thumbnails, logos or avatars.
Cards have a prominent image with text placed beneath, not overlaid.
Some cards have images, others don't, or not stated.

attributes.name: card excerpt and metadata density
attributes.definition: How much secondary text (excerpt, metadata) cards carry.

values.definition: Only hero or lead cards show an excerpt; others show title and meta.
Cards show only a few bare metadata items such as author and count.
Statement does not address excerpt or metadata density.

attributes.name: card edge accent
attributes.definition: Presence and position of a colored border or bar on a card edge.

values.definition: Colored border or bar along the card's top edge.
Colored border along the card's left edge.

attributes.name: card size uniformity
attributes.definition: Whether cards share a uniform shape/size or vary in treatment.

values.definition: All cards identical tall portrait format.
Cards differ in treatment by position (hero vs later).
